Build full-body strength and muscular endurance in just 20 minutes with this military-style calisthenics workout you can do anywhere — no gym, no weights, and no equipment required.
This beginner-to-intermediate full-body bodyweight workout combines military-style calisthenics exercises to train your chest, triceps, legs, back, and core. We'll work for 40 seconds and rest for 20 seconds, giving you enough recovery to maintain good form while challenging your strength, muscular endurance, and overall conditioning.
WORKOUT
WARM-UP (3 MINUTES)
• Jumping Jacks
